name: flash-backup
description: Takes 30-40 minutes: the PCM writes to USB slowly (~30 KB/s), so leave the stick in until the screen says DONE -- the screen shows how many MB are copied. Put the car on a battery charger first (or keep the engine running): the PCM must stay on the whole time, and a copy cut short by the car switching off has to be started again.Copies the PCM's whole 64 MB flash (bootloader, system images and /HBpersistence) to the USB stick as pcm_flash.bin, plus the activation file and stored VIN next to it. Read-only -- it is the same read the PCM's own engineering menu does (CustomerService option 05), without needing the menu. Make one before any update or experiment, then check it on a computer with PCM-Explorer (python explorer.py pcm_flash.bin check). Never overwrites an earlier backup; a copy cut short (stick pulled or full) is deleted on the next run and reported; a second copy never runs alongside the first. The file holds your VIN and activations, so don't post it. See RECOVERY.md.
author: dspl1236
